headline: Weathered Expanse Still Heaviest Fight; Colonials Win Back Two Works in Mooring County
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse remains the war's heaviest affray, seventy-one events in the past day and several in the last few hours, its ground split five Warden works, one Colonial and three unclaimed; Wightwalk and Frostmarch account for most of the traffic, with the latest change reported at 14:33 this afternoon. The chief reversal of this edition is in Mooring County, which the last dispatch set wholly under Warden hand: Colonials have since reclaimed two of its twelve works, and the sector logged five events in two hours and eleven in six, chiefly about MacConmara Barrows, The Cut and Gravekeeper's Holdfast. Marban Hollow has flared again after a quiet spell, eighteen events in a day and five in two hours, most at Checkpoint Bua, where two works stand unclaimed. Stlican Shelf keeps one Warden work against eight Colonial, with Briar and Breaker Town busy. Linn Mercy reports a sharp rise in bloodshed, 817 Colonial and 1,857 Warden casualties in two hours, and a Warden capture at Lathair. Nevish Line and Callahan's Passage continue their costlier but slower exchange. Thirty-four towns remain the mark for victory.
